title: 第11章 我的眼睛能顿悟第12章 找抽的是你
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
离开了房间，楚天铭发现韩清雪的房门紧闭，似乎仍在熟睡当中，因此也没有打扰，直接向着韩家的武技阁走去。
一路之上，遇到了不少的韩家之人。
而他们大部分都是对楚天铭避之三舍，至于剩下的人也都是投来厌恶的目光。
不过楚天铭没有理会。
他知道，现在韩家的人，还依旧将他当成外人而已。
而他想要获得尊重，那么就需要更强大的实力。
他明白，尊严永远存在剑锋之上，而不是靠别人施舍。
很快。
他便来到了一座三层高的阁楼前，不断有已经踏入御气境界的韩家弟子，进进出出。
“这便是武技阁了吧。”
楚天铭神色一动，然后迈步走入了武技阁当中。
看守武技阁的，乃是韩家的一位太上长老，名叫韩铁山。
此人在韩家威望极高，即便韩家家主韩正德看到他，都要恭敬行礼。
“晚辈楚天铭，前来挑选武技。”
楚天铭走到那韩铁山面前，毕恭毕敬的说道。
“楚天铭？你就是那个瞎了眼的楚家小子？”
韩铁山捋了捋发白的胡须，上下打量着楚天铭。
“晚辈正是。”
楚天铭轮回天目微微转动，发现这韩铁山身上散发出来的灵气波动，浩瀚如海，竟然比韩正德还要可怕许多，不由肃然起敬。
“我听清雪那丫头提起过你，我们韩家的门风一向正派，你能进入韩家，也说明你的人品还不错，以后你跟清雪一样，称呼我铁山爷爷便是。”

韩铁山颔首一笑，看起来十分和蔼可亲。
然而楚天铭可不知道，这位韩铁山，乃是韩家最强之人，而且脾气火爆，就是韩家家主韩正德都不敢招惹他。
“多谢铁山爷爷。”
楚天铭抱拳回道。
“不必多礼，你这次来武技阁，是来挑选武技和功法的吧。”
韩铁山目光闪烁的问道。
楚天铭点了点头：“正是。”
韩铁山看了楚天铭一眼，然后微微皱起眉头：“你的气息很古怪，老夫竟然看不穿你的真实修为。”
楚天铭挠了挠头，也是一脸茫然，按理来说以韩铁山的修为，肯定能轻而易举的看破他的真实修为才对。
难不成轮回天目，还有隐藏他修为的能力？
他虽然诧异，但是眼下也没有时间去多想，向着韩铁山说道：“晚辈的修为，已经到了御气五重。”
“御气五重？”
韩铁山听到这话，顿时身躯一震，不可思议道：“我听清雪那丫头说，你前不久才能修炼，这才一个多月的时间，就御气五重了？瞎小子，你不会是在糊弄老夫吧。”
“晚辈不敢。”
楚天铭见到韩铁山不相信，只好将体内的气息，释放出来，刹那间一股强劲的灵气，从他身上爆发出来，形成了一道罡风，吹向四周。
“哈哈，还真御气五重了，而且似乎比一般御气五重武者的气息强了不少，看来你这小家伙并非什么无法修炼的瞎子，而是一个百年难遇的天才，不错不错！”
韩铁山见此，不禁哈哈大笑道。
“铁山爷爷过誉了。”
楚天铭被韩铁山夸的有些不好意思起来。
“以你的修为，可以到武技阁第二层里挑选武技，不过老夫这次破例一回，你可直接进入第三层，那里的武技和功法，是韩家最好的，不过记住，只能选一种武技。”

韩铁山开口说道。
content_en:
After leaving the room, Chu Tianming found that Han Qingxue's door was closed and she seemed to be still asleep, so he did not disturb him and walked directly to the Han family's martial arts pavilion.
Along the way, I met many people from the Han family.
Most of them avoided Chu Tianming, and the remaining people also cast disgusted looks.
But Chu Tianming ignored it.
He knew that people in the Han family still regarded him as an outsider.
And if he wants to gain respect, he needs stronger strength.
He understands that dignity always exists on the edge of the sword and does not rely on charity from others.
soon.
He came to a three-story attic, and disciples of the Han family who had entered the realm of air control were constantly coming in and out.
"This is the Martial Arts Pavilion."
Chu Tianming's expression changed, and then he stepped into the martial arts pavilion.
The person guarding the Martial Arts Pavilion is a supreme elder of the Han family named Han Tieshan.
This person has a very high prestige in the Han family. Even if Han Zhengde, the head of the Han family, sees him, he must bow respectfully.
"Junior Chu Tianming, come here to choose martial arts."
Chu Tianming walked up to Han Tieshan and said respectfully.
"Chu Tianming? Are you the blind boy from the Chu family?"
Han Tieshan smoothed his white beard and looked Chu Tianming up and down.
"Junior is exactly that."
Chu Tianming's reincarnation eyes turned slightly, and he found that the spiritual energy fluctuations emanating from Han Tieshan's body were as vast as the sea. They were much scarier than Han Zhengde, and he couldn't help but feel awe.
"I heard that girl Qingxue mention you. The family tradition of our Han family has always been upright. Your ability to enter the Han family also shows that your character is not bad. From now on, just like Qingxue, you will call me Grandpa Tieshan."
Han Tieshan nodded and smiled, looking very amiable.
However, Chu Tianming didn't know that Han Tieshan was the strongest person in the Han family and had a hot temper. Even the head of the Han family, Han Zhengde, did not dare to provoke him.
"Thank you, Grandpa Tieshan."
Chu Tianming replied with clasped fists.
"No need to be polite. You came to the Martial Arts Pavilion this time to choose martial arts and exercises."
Han Tieshan asked with twinkling eyes.
Chu Tianming nodded: "Exactly."
Han Tieshan glanced at Chu Tianming, then frowned slightly: "Your aura is very strange. I can't see through your true cultivation level."
Chu Tianming scratched his head and looked confused. Logically speaking, with Han Tieshan's cultivation level, he would be able to easily see through his true cultivation level.
Is it possible that the Samsara Third Eye still has the ability to hide his cultivation?
Although he was surprised, he had no time to think about it at the moment and said to Han Tieshan: "This junior's cultivation has reached the fifth level of Qi Control."
"Fifth level of air control?"
When Han Tieshan heard this, his body suddenly shook and he said in disbelief: "I heard that girl Qingxue say that you were able to practice not long ago, and in just over a month, you have reached the fifth level of Qi Control? Blind boy, you are not fooling me, are you?"
"Juniors don't dare."
When Chu Tianming saw that Han Tieshan didn't believe it, he had no choice but to release the aura in his body. In an instant, a strong spiritual energy burst out from his body, forming a strong wind and blowing around.
"Haha, you are really at the fifth level of Qi control, and it seems to be much stronger than the average Qi control warrior at the fifth level. It seems that you are not a blind man who cannot practice, but a genius that is rare to see in a century. Not bad!"
Seeing this, Han Tieshan couldn't help laughing.
"Grandpa Tieshan is too praised."
Chu Tianming felt a little embarrassed after being praised by Han Tieshan.
"With your level of cultivation, you can go to the second floor of the Martial Arts Pavilion to choose martial arts. However, I will make an exception this time. You can directly enter the third floor. The martial arts and techniques there are the best in the Han family. But remember, you can only choose one martial skill."
Han Tieshan said.
